author: Lachlan & Sophie M.
headline: Exceptional tiling precision – true master craftsmen
content: A1 Tiling completed our master ensuite renovation with large-format porcelain slabs and herringbone feature tiles. The grout lines are laser straight, the waterproofing was thoroughly done to Australian standards, and the team left the site spotless every day. Highly recommended!

author: Marcus Davies
headline: Flawless pool waterline and coping finishes
content: We engaged A1 Tiling for our pool waterline glass mosaics and surrounding alfresco travertine paving. Their attention to levels and mitred corner joints is unmatched. Outstanding communication and delivered ahead of schedule.

author: Elena Rostova
headline: Stunning marble waterfall island & precision floor alignment
content: From the initial quote to the final clean, A1 Tiling was professional, punctual, and highly skilled. The mitred 45-degree waterfall edge on our marble kitchen island is a work of art. Best tilers in Queensland!

author: David Chen
serviceType: Natural Stone Feature Wall & Bath Suite
headline: Architectural stone masonry at its finest
content: The custom dry-stacked stone feature wall in our Noosa holiday home exceeded all expectations. The texture and lighting reveal the depth of their stonework. Honest pricing, licensed QBCC work, and top-tier execution.

author: Brett & Sarah W.
headline: Seamless large-format tiles with zero lippage
content: Tiled over 180sqm of open-plan living and wet areas. Lippage-free leveling, immaculate silicone expansion joints, and great advice on tile layout during the prep stage. Couldn't be happier with the outcome.

author: Amanda Thornton
headline: Prompt quote, reliable timeline, and flawless finish
content: After dealing with poor workmanship from previous contractors, A1 Tiling came in and rectified our leaking balcony tiles, reapplied certified waterproofing, and re-tiled beautifully. Absolute lifesavers.
